Run `node vendor/web-access-source/rebuild.mjs` from the Scrum package root. Node 24 is required. Web/worktree recipes use esbuild 0.28.2 from the development dependencies. The audio recipe installs pinned build-only dependencies into a new temporary directory with lifecycle scripts disabled. It does not change the installed runtime. A different bundle fails verification. Source labels and attribution are retained for reproducibility.
